title: SALVATION FOR ALL

blocks.text: “Yes, Jesus loves you and is daily watching over you until final fulfillment or until being changed into a glorified body!” – “He commanded us to love one another, how could He do less than love His own people. Amen!” – “We preach it here often about His goodness, salvation and deliverance and that is what this letter will be about!” “Ps. 103:2-3 says, don’t forget all His benefits! Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases!” – “You have it by simple faith acceptance!” – Isa. 55:11, “So shall my Word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto Me void!” – Eph. 2:8-9, “For by grace are ye saved through FAITH; and that not of yourselves: it is the GIFT of God: not of works, lest any man should boast!” – Simple repentance, acceptance in the heart does it. – “Men reject and neglect the salvation of God because it is free! They refuse to believe Jesus! – But it is free as a gift only because Jesus has already paid the price!” – “Behold, read ye this in Heb. 2:3, “How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation?” – “It is a gift, one simply repents, accepts! Such simplicity men cast it aside! – You receive of your own believing the eternal gift of life!”

“Some people have said they cannot always feel that they are saved, so how does one know that they are saved? One cannot always go by feeling because the flesh will make you feel sometimes like you aren’t saved when you are! – Don’t ever solely go by what the flesh says, but ‘by faith’ plainly in and boldly declare what ‘the Word says’ and has done!” – “It’s impossible to please God without faith in His promised Word!” (Heb. 11:6) – “Now the just shall live by FAITH!” (Heb. 10:38) – “We are to trust in the Lord and not lean to our own understanding. Acknowledge Him and He shall direct thy paths! (Prov. 3:5-6) Goodness alone will not do it, but believing and acting on ALL He says will do it!” Rom. 1:16, “The gospel is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth!” Acteth means: repent – repeat promises – give – accept – thanksgiving, have divine love – prayer and praise! Also in helping (support) to get the gospel out! – It says to him that acteth!”

“Also you know you are saved when you can still repent no matter if it’s the least little bit wrong that you may have done to others, etc.” – “And here is another real way to know! If you can forgive others, you, yourself are forgiven!” Matt. 6:14-15, “But if ye forgive not men their trespasses neither will your father (Jesus) forgive your trespasses!” – “Just knowing who Jesus really is brings the most beautiful salvation and filling of the Holy Spirit that one can contain! – Rejoice!” Isa. 9:6, “His name shall be called Jesus, the Mighty God, the Everlasting Father, the Prince of Peace!” – I John 1:9 reveals God’s kindness! “If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness!” – Verse 10 goes on to say, “If we say we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.” – I John 3:1, “Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God!” And in verse 2 it says that when we shall see Him, that we shall be like Him! Amen! – “Behold receive ye Jesus, the first and the last, the beginning and the end and ye shall live in eternity sharing in My glory and kingdoms wherein there is no end! Glory!”

“It’s accepted just exactly as this Scripture is here, Rom. 10:10, “For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with ‘the mouth confession’ is made unto salvation.” – Acts 4:12 reveals, “Neither is there salvation in any other name, but the Lord Jesus!” – “People can receive salvation by repenting and repeating the name Jesus and also can receive healing and blessings in the same manner!” – “Be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is!” (Eph. 5:17) – “And the Word (Jesus) was made flesh and dwelt among us!” (St. John. 1:14) “Many people say they have found Jesus as their Saviour, but they will never know what true fulfillment is until they have also found Him as Lord and head of all things!” – (Col. 2:9-10) – “The Scriptures infallibly and plainly state that when we see Jesus, we have seen the Everlasting Father!” (St. John 14:7-9) – “And for those who truly believe this, verse 14 will become part of their life, that is in heavenly things to come and in His promises!” – “Ye shall ask anything in my name and I will do it!” – “Who hath blessed us with ALL spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ!” (Eph. 1:3) “Yea, my child listen…The Lord that hath begun a good work in you will perform it unto the day of Jesus Christ! (Phil. 1:6) – For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of His good pleasure!” (Phil. 2:13) – I John 2:17, “But the world passeth away, but He who doeth the will of God abideth forever!” – “The Lord loves to see His people in renewing their mind towards Him that ye may prove that perfect will of God!” (Rom. 12:2) – “Also another point, generally when you receive salvation Satan will test, tempt and agitate, disturb and upset you in any way possible, but the Scriptures say resist him and he will flee!” – “Also take the sword of the spirit which is the Word of God and rebuke him!” – “Be ye doers of the Word and not hearers only!” (James 1:22) – “Neither will He let you be tempted above that you are able, but will make a way of escape!” (I Cor. 10:13) – “Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus!” (II Tim. 2:1) “Put on the full armour against the devil and his plans!” – (Eph. 6:10-11) – “Yea, whosoever hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from the fear of evil!” (Prov. 1:33) – “Trust in the living God who giveth us richly all things to enjoy!” (I Tim. 6:17)

When you have time you should read this Scripture, “For we are more than conquerors through Him that loved us! Letting nothing separate us from the love and Jesus our Lord!” (Rom. 8:37-39) – “The rest of the verses will encourage you!” – “This letter was written by the Holy Spirit to help you in the days to come, and if you ever feel lonely or tested always read this letter and the Lord will bless you! For He says, I will never forsake you but will keep you as you simply trust Him daily!”
In God’s abundant love and care,
